* `Becoming.Propagation` (L4): how much difference arrives, with no premise beyond what each law
  names. In two balanced flows a condition's gap changes across a step by exactly the difference
  given less the difference taken. An exchange is coupled to a level with strength at most `k`
  where changing that level alone changes what it exchanges by at most `k` times as much
  (`ExchangeLaw.RespondsWithin`): strength zero is insensitivity, and strengths add up over levels
  changed one at a time, bounding a part's share of a move. Where the rest follows a law of what
  has stood with such strengths, every gap is at most the carried amount, the course one law
  generates from the part's gaps and the strengths (`gap_le_carried`); that law attains it, so the
  carried amount is the most difference that can arrive (`most_difference_arrives`). It is
  positive exactly along a route in time of positive strengths, on routes of `TimedResponse`'s
  spread where they are registered; carried differences add. A held difference arrives without
  bound through a chain, and a loop of strength one doubles it every step.

paragraph_zh: **差别到达多少（第一部分）。** 回应所及说差别能到哪里，敏感说一个水平能否改变一个交换，都不说多少（[Becoming.Propagation](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Propagation.lean)）。两个水平之差（`gap`：任一方多于另一方者）跨一步恰按所给之差减所取之差改变：两个平衡的流中，第一个流某条件步后的水平与第二个流步前的水平，加第一个所取与第二个所给，等于第二个步后的水平与第一个步前的水平，加第二个所取与第一个所给（`levels_step_exact`）。所以一个条件跨一步之差至多是步前之差加与它交换的每个形成的交换之差（`gap_step`），每个交换都相同时不增（`gap_step_of_alike`）。一个形成与一个条件的交换在某步与一个条件的水平耦合，强度至多 k，是说在只在该水平上不同的两个历史下，所取与所给之差合计至多是 k 乘该水平之差（`ExchangeLaw.RespondsWithin`）：这是敏感的度量。对读已立者的律，强度为零恰是不敏感（`ExchangeLaw.insensitiveAt_iff_strength_zero`、`ExchangeLaw.sensitive_iff_strength`）；强度沿逐个改变的水平相加（`ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_mixCells`、`ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_strengths`），所以一个动作的改变至多是部分的份额（其强度乘部分的改变）加其余的份额（`ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_shares`）。有限的强度是律的条件，不是每个律都有：给出水平平方的律没有（`Propagation.Square.not_respondsWithin`）。携带之律让部分给出其差，部分之外的每个形成给出其强度对至今各水平所作的，什么也不取（`ExchangeLaw.carrying`）；所携带的量是它由起始之差生成的进程（`carried`，由 `Becoming.Counterfactual` 的生成）。其余在两个流中遵从同一个具有这些强度的读已立者之律、部分至多差其所给之差、起始至多差起始之差时，每步每个条件之差至多是所携带的量（`gap_le_carried`）。它恰好达到：携带之律具有这些强度，它的进程与安静的进程之差恰是所携带的量（`ExchangeLaw.carrying_respondsWithin`、`carried_attained`），所以所携带的量是能到达的最大差别（`most_difference_arrives`，一个当且仅当）。它恰沿正强度的时间路线为正（`Conveyed`、`carried_pos_iff`），没有路线处两个流的水平相同（`levels_alike_of_not_conveyed`）；正强度为所识者时，这些路线是 `TimedResponse` 之传播的路线（`Conveyed.spread`）。所携带的差别相加（`carried_add`），更多的差与更大的强度携带更多（`carried_mono`）。见证：一次给出的一个单位，其余每步以其水平的两倍转给第二个条件，到第 t + 1 步在那里到达 2t，没有回路也无界（`Propagation.Chain.keeps_arriving`）；强度为一的回路把它送回，到达 2^t（`Propagation.Loop.runaway`）。读法（AI 的，待 Ren 或按其 2026-10-15 的交托判断）：耦合强度是敏感所缺的度量，敏感说能否，强度说多强；差别到达多少本身是一个进程，由一个律生成，从展开读出而不另加；所持的差别不断到达，因为水平持有所给的。强度本身是给出的界，不陈述最小的强度；回路的一般理论、无穷多条件、连续时间与实数的量都不推出。见 [how-much-difference-arrives](../results/records/how-much-difference-arrives.md)。
paragraph_en: **How much difference arrives (Part I).** The responsive reach says where a difference can go, and sensitivity whether a level can change an exchange; neither says how much ([Becoming.Propagation](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Propagation.lean)). Across a step the difference of two levels (`gap`, what either has beyond the other) changes by exactly the difference given less the difference taken: in two balanced flows, the first's level of a condition after the step and the second's before, with what the first takes and the second gives, equal the second's level after and the first's before, with what the second takes and the first gives (`levels_step_exact`). So a condition's gap across a step is at most its gap before with the gaps of every exchange with it (`gap_step`), and does not grow where every exchange is alike (`gap_step_of_alike`). A formation's exchange with a condition is coupled to the level of a condition at a step with strength at most k where, under any two histories differing in that level only, what it takes and gives differ in all by at most k times that level's gap (`ExchangeLaw.RespondsWithin`): the measure of sensitivity. For a law of what has stood, strength zero is insensitivity (`ExchangeLaw.insensitiveAt_iff_strength_zero`, `ExchangeLaw.sensitive_iff_strength`); strengths add up over levels changed one at a time (`ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_mixCells`, `ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_strengths`), so the change of a move is at most the part's share, its strengths times the part's change, with the rest's share (`ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_shares`). A finite strength is a condition on a law, not given with every law: a law giving the square of a level has none (`Propagation.Square.not_respondsWithin`). The carrying law has the part give its gaps and each formation outside it give what its strengths make of the levels so far, taking nothing (`ExchangeLaw.carrying`); the carried amount is the course it generates from the starting gaps (`carried`, by `Becoming.Counterfactual`'s generation). Where the rest follows in both flows one law of what has stood with those strengths, the part differing by at most its gaps and the starting levels by at most theirs, every gap at every step is at most the carried amount (`gap_le_carried`). It is attained: the carrying law has those strengths, and its course differs from the quiet course by exactly the carried amount (`ExchangeLaw.carrying_respondsWithin`, `carried_attained`), so the carried amount is the most difference that can arrive (`most_difference_arrives`, an equivalence). It is positive exactly along a route in time of positive strengths (`Conveyed`, `carried_pos_iff`); where there is none the two flows' levels agree (`levels_alike_of_not_conveyed`), and where the positive strengths are registered the routes are those of `TimedResponse`'s spread (`Conveyed.spread`). Carried differences add (`carried_add`), and more gaps and larger strengths carry more (`carried_mono`). Witnesses: one unit given once, which the rest relays each step to a second condition at twice its level, arrives there as 2t by step t + 1, without bound and with no loop (`Propagation.Chain.keeps_arriving`); returned by a loop of strength one, it arrives as 2^t (`Propagation.Loop.runaway`). On the AI's reading, pending Ren or decided on Ren's delegation of 15 October: the coupling strength is the measure sensitivity lacked, sensitivity saying whether and the strength how strongly; how much difference arrives is itself a course, generated by one law and read off the unfolding rather than added to it; a held difference keeps arriving, since levels hold what they are given. The strengths themselves are supplied bounds, and no least strength is stated; a general theory of loops, infinitely many conditions, continuous time and real amounts are not derived. See [how-much-difference-arrives](../results/records/how-much-difference-arrives.md).
whole_zh: - **差别到达多少。** 两个平衡的流中，一个条件之差跨一步恰按所给之差减所取之差改变（`levels_step_exact`）；交换与一个水平的耦合强度度量敏感，强度为零恰是不敏感（`ExchangeLaw.insensitiveAt_iff_strength_zero`），强度沿逐个改变的水平相加；其余遵从具有这些强度的读已立者之律时，每个差至多是所携带的量，它恰好达到，是能到达的最大差别（`most_difference_arrives`），恰沿正强度的时间路线为正（`carried_pos_iff`）。
whole_en: - **How much difference arrives.** In two balanced flows a condition's gap changes across a step by exactly the difference given less the difference taken (`levels_step_exact`); the strength with which an exchange is coupled to a level measures sensitivity, strength zero being insensitivity (`ExchangeLaw.insensitiveAt_iff_strength_zero`), and strengths add up over levels changed one at a time; where the rest follows a law of what has stood with those strengths, every gap is at most the carried amount, which is attained and so is the most difference that can arrive (`most_difference_arrives`), and is positive exactly along a route in time of positive strengths (`carried_pos_iff`).
glossary_strength: | 耦合强度 | coupling strength | 形成与一个条件的交换在某步与一个条件的水平耦合，强度至多 k：只在该水平上不同的两个历史下，所取与所给之差合计至多 k 乘该水平之差；敏感的度量：对读已立者的律，强度为零恰是不敏感；强度沿逐个改变的水平相加，界定部分在一个动作中的份额；不是每个律都有有限的强度 | `ExchangeLaw.RespondsWithin`、`ExchangeLaw.insensitiveAt_iff_strength_zero`、`ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_strengths`、`ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_shares`、`Propagation.Square.not_respondsWithin` |
glossary_carried: | 所携带的量 | carried amount | 携带之律由起始之差与部分之差按耦合强度生成的进程；其余遵从具有这些强度的读已立者之律时，每个差至多是它，且它恰好达到：能到达的最大差别；恰沿正强度的时间路线为正 | `ExchangeLaw.carrying`、`carried`、`gap_le_carried`、`most_difference_arrives`、`carried_pos_iff`、`Conveyed` |
